title: Decide whether an Engram Defer or a long non-failure wait should restart the 240 s admission budget
outcome: The policy is decided and either implemented or documented. Today the 240 s admission budget starts at a head's first acceptance for control admission and lasts until delivery, but it is enforced only from the first prepared-Begin hold. So a head that waited longer for another reason, such as an Engram Defer (not a failure) or another recovery, gets no automatic re-admission on its first prepared-Begin failure.
acceptance: Decide whether an Engram Defer or a long non-failure wait should restart the 240 s admission budget is done
